- Stack: pnpm + Turbo monorepo; NestJS API + MongoDB + React/Vite front; shared Zod schemas/datasets in packages/shared and UI kit in packages/ui (see [package.json](package.json), [turbo.json](turbo.json)).
- Workspaces: apps/api (Nest), apps/web (React), packages/shared (schemas, rune data, SM2), packages/ui (React components) referenced via workspace:* versions.
- Global tasks: `pnpm dev` runs all dev servers in parallel; `pnpm -r build` builds shared → ui → api → web; `pnpm -r typecheck` across packages; `pnpm -r clean` removes dist/.turbo/node_modules.
- Env: API reads [apps/api/src/config/env.validation.ts](apps/api/src/config/env.validation.ts) (MONGODB_URI, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRES_IN, API_PORT defaults 4000); React uses VITE_API_URL or VITE_API_BASE_URL for axios base (default http://localhost:4000/api).
- API server: global prefix `/api`, CORS origin: true, port from PORT/API_PORT (see [apps/api/src/server.ts](apps/api/src/server.ts)).
- API modules wired in [apps/api/src/app.module.ts](apps/api/src/app.module.ts): Auth, Runes, Tools, Progress, Ritual, Study, Lore, Stats, Health; Mongoose connects via MONGODB_URI with 10s timeouts.
- DTO validation: use `ZodValidationPipe` with shared schemas (see [apps/api/src/common/pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts](apps/api/src/common/pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts)); backend expects Zod DTOs from packages/shared rather than Nest class-validators.
- Auth: JWT strategy reads bearer token, payload {sub,email,handle} (see [apps/api/src/auth/jwt.strategy.ts](apps/api/src/auth/jwt.strategy.ts)); guarded routes use JwtGuard + GetUser decorator (see [apps/api/src/common/auth/get-user.decorator.ts](apps/api/src/common/auth/get-user.decorator.ts)).
- Auth flows: signup/login accept {email,password,handle?}, hash with bcrypt, handle sanitized/derived from email, returns {token,user:{id,email,handle}} (see [apps/api/src/auth/auth.service.ts](apps/api/src/auth/auth.service.ts)).
- Users: Mongo schema enforces unique email and required handle (see [apps/api/src/users/user.schema.ts](apps/api/src/users/user.schema.ts)); UsersService helpers find/create/safeProfile (see [apps/api/src/users/users.service.ts](apps/api/src/users/users.service.ts)).
- Runes: GET /api/runes optionally filters by q/aett; service queries Mongo first then falls back to in-memory ELDER_FUTHARK dataset (see [apps/api/src/runes/runes.service.ts](apps/api/src/runes/runes.service.ts), [packages/shared/src/runes/elderFuthark.ts](packages/shared/src/runes/elderFuthark.ts)).
- Seeding: runes seeder upserts shared dataset into Mongo, validating with shared Rune schema and MONGODB_URI (see [apps/api/src/seed.ts](apps/api/src/seed.ts)).
- Progress/achievements: ProgressService lazily creates progress doc, tracks streak/totalStudyReviews and unlocks achievements idempotently (see [apps/api/src/progress/progress.service.ts](apps/api/src/progress/progress.service.ts)).
- Study (spaced repetition): StudyService auto-ensures a card per rune using shared SM2 helpers sm2Init/sm2Review and updates dueAt/repetitions/easeFactor/lapses; increments totalStudyReviews and unlocks SR_10_REVIEWS/SR_50_REVIEWS (see [apps/api/src/study/study.service.ts](apps/api/src/study/study.service.ts), [packages/shared/src/tools/sm2.ts](packages/shared/src/tools/sm2.ts)).
- Stats: StatsService queries raw Mongo collections (configurable names in COLLECTIONS) to compute streaks/points/leaderboard; resilient to missing collections/fields (see [apps/api/src/stats/stats.service.ts](apps/api/src/stats/stats.service.ts)).
- Shared schemas: Auth/Login/Signup, Rune DTOs/list query, Study grading schema, achievements/lore/etc. live in packages/shared/src/schemas; re-exported from [packages/shared/src/index.ts](packages/shared/src/index.ts).
- Shared tools: transliteration modes phonetic/simple-substitution/reverse/atbash mapping to rune glyphs/keys (see [packages/shared/src/tools/transliteration.ts](packages/shared/src/tools/transliteration.ts)); runeOfDay helper and stroke recognition templates re-exported via shared index.
- Frontend API client: axios instance with baseURL from Vite env; setAuthToken adds Authorization header (see [apps/web/src/lib/api.ts](apps/web/src/lib/api.ts)).
- Frontend auth state: AuthProvider stores token/user in localStorage (efa_token/efa_user), sets axios auth header, exposes login/signup/logout/clearError; errors normalized from Nest response shapes (see [apps/web/src/lib/auth.tsx](apps/web/src/lib/auth.tsx)).
- Frontend routing: React Router with AppShell root and child pages for runes, flashcards, study, quiz, tools (draw/transliterate), ritual, stones, lore, progress, stats, signin; fallback NotFound provides helpful shortcuts (see [apps/web/src/routes.tsx](apps/web/src/routes.tsx)).
- Frontend data: React Query client in [apps/web/src/lib/queryClient.ts](apps/web/src/lib/queryClient.ts); styles via Tailwind config in apps/web/tailwind.config.cjs and global CSS at apps/web/src/styles.css.
- Dataset/contracts: consumer UIs should rely on shared exports (ELDER_FUTHARK, RuneSchema, StudyGradeSchema, LoginSchema) to avoid schema drift between API and web.
- Deployment (Render): build commands install with NODE_ENV=development to pull devDeps, then build shared→ui→api/web; api start uses `pnpm -C apps/api start`, web publishes apps/web/dist with SPA rewrite (see [render.yaml](render.yaml)).
- When adding endpoints: prefer ZodValidationPipe with shared schemas, register module in AppModule, expose via /api prefix, and add minimal Mongo schema + service mirroring existing patterns.
- When consuming API from web: use api axios instance, ensure AuthProvider is mounted (see [apps/web/src/main.tsx](apps/web/src/main.tsx)), and invalidate react-query cache via shared queryClient when mutating data.
- If you change collection names/schemas later, update StatsService COLLECTIONS and any raw queries to keep leaderboard/overview resilient.
- Keep ASCII; prefer concise comments only for non-obvious logic. Avoid reverting user changes or using destructive git commands.
